_doc: The holy city (Rev 21-22): the garden heart (room 0,0, unchanged) and the district below it (rooms 0,1 and 1,1). Numbers mirror art/build_scene.py and art/build_district.py. Rects [x, y, w, h]; demo waypoints [x, y, pause].
hint: E: talk with someone nearby    Esc: menu

gate.verse:
And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day...
And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
Revelation 21:25-26

zones: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him.  Rev 22:3
And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.  Rev 21:24
And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.  Rev 21:23
In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.  John 14:2
The twelve gates were twelve pearls; every gate was of one pearl.  Rev 21:21
A pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne.  Rev 22:1
On either side of the river was the tree of life... the leaves were for the healing of the nations.  Rev 22:2
The tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month.  Rev 22:2
The wall was of jasper; its foundations garnished with all manner of precious stones.  Rev 21:18-19
The street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.  Rev 21:21
people: Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.  Rev 7:10
In thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.  Ps 16:11
God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying.  Rev 21:4
Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.  Rev 5:13
There shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light.  Rev 22:5
They shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.  Isa 35:10
Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.  Rev 19:6
Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.  Rev 7:12
Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard... the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.  1 Cor 2:9
Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people.  Rev 21:3
In my Father's house are many mansions... I go to prepare a place for you.  John 14:2
Let not your heart be troubled... In my Father's house are many mansions.  John 14:1-2
And his servants shall serve him: and they shall see his face.  Rev 22:3-4
Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.  Rev 22:14
And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new.  Rev 21:5
He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.  Rev 21:7
